_meta.note: structures: {step, index} for setFeatureSeed, set = the random_spread structure set that places it (none for the stronghold, placed by rings, nor the mineshafts, whose set is in before). before: what a chunk places before its stronghold, [id, type, set, biomes its start must stand in, for what is neither jigsaw nor a mineshaft] in order, and the random_spread grid of each set that is not jigsaw (frequency, method = frequency_reduction_method); after: the same for what it places after it. (salt, spacing, separation, spread, its weighted structures). tables: pools of [rolls min, max] and entries [item ("" = empty), weight, functions, and the biome ids its loot origin must stand in when it has a location_check]: [set_count, min, max] | [enchant_with_levels, min, max, candidate ids] | [enchant_randomly, candidate ids], candidates in the options order already filtered for the item. enchantments: [weight, max level, min cost base, per level, max cost base, per level, exclusive ids]. enchantable: the item component (0 = none). templates: s = size, c = RandomizableContainers [x, y, z] and m = DATA markers [x, y, z, metadata], both in template-local (y, x, z) order; g = base64 of 2-bit cell codes in (y, z, x) order (0 the world stays, 1 air, 2 a block, 3 a chest).
